what: Exact values of V(n) and the unit scale of the twelve blocks: unconditional statements decided from certificates and colourings, two finite tests of the conditional theorems, and the controls that must be refused.
saysFirst: Two kinds of statement are decided here, and they are kept apart. UNCONDITIONAL: exact values of V(n), the least number of monochromatic 3-term progressions over the 2-colourings of 1..n, each by a certificate a short checker verifies in exact arithmetic and a colouring; they use nothing but the definition. NOT DECIDED: the two models' theorems about every large n (the exact formula from n = 15,756, every multiple of 548 beyond the first): each was read once, by the other model, and rests on the unrefereed October result.
theorems: NOT DECIDED HERE: the two models' statements about every large n were each read once, by the other model

U1.text: V(n) exact at 95 of 95 lengths (n = 1..95), each by a certificate that passes the checker and a colouring that attains it; 33368 cubes in all

U6.text: for every n = 1..3288 some colouring has exactly A(n): the table's mask on C_n at 3283 lengths, the replacement colourings at n = [23, 24, 25, 31, 33]

E1.whyNotRefused: every rational tangent vector gives a true inequality, so a perturbed vector makes the certificate wrong only if the replay stops closing; this one still closes. The control was badly chosen by the pre-registration (amendment A2). In a sweep over all 201 vectors the same perturbation stops the replay in 191.

V548.text: V(548) = 15,756 exactly, with exactly 102 labelled minimising colourings: E1 puts every colouring with at most 15,756 (or its colour exchange) inside the sub-cube of U3, where U3 gives at least 15,756 and U4 gives exactly 51 at 15,756; the 51 and their colour exchanges are 102 distinct colourings.
V548.uses: no theorem about the continuum and no paper lemma; the October certificate files as numbers whose identities are verified, and the four slab bounds of this repository's delta-three verifier
